messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — sudden p99 latency spike on streaming endpoints for region eu-west-1 (auto-alert). Alert id: INC-3105. Metrics: p95 -> 420ms (baseline 180ms), p99 -> 2.3s (baseline 300ms). Stream stall count +410% in last 5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy event 2026-03-15T09:01Z: rollout prefix-scheme-v3 to runtime-cluster-02. Image: inference-runtime:v4.7. Deploy ID: DPL-7891.

ashley: seeing a lot of `streaming.conn.stall` traces in the trace UI. Most originate from handler shard 7-10. Heatmap attached in observability (link).

mike: fwiw we rolled prefix-scheme-v3 at 09:01 as part of the cache salting experiment. It changed the prefix hash salt and introduced a new lookup path `kv://prefixed/v3/<prefix>` which might explain mass cache misses.

raj: confirmed — cache hit-rate for prefix namespace `app/prefix/v1` down from 87% -> 12% after 09:01. Misses correlate with elevated backend CPU and an uptick in downstream paging.

ashley: customer-facing impact — some websocket streams seeing token pacing; clients report repeated `RST_STREAM` and delayed packets (support tickets 4512, 4513). CS flagged two high-usage customers (acme-inc, papertrail) with elevated error rates.

luis: I can confirm ACME seeing error spikes: 5xx on our ingest endpoint and partial stream truncation. Sending them a brief.

caroline: looping in CS; I've opened a customer incident message template. Will notify customers as "degraded streaming performance" and list mitigations.

nicholas: added dashboard panels: `streaming_tail_latency`, `kv_prefix_hit_rate`, `handler_queue_depth`. Query snippets: `rate(streaming_tail_latency_ms_bucket[1m])` and `sum(kv_prefix_hits)/sum(kv_prefix_lookups)` for hit ratio.

ashley: immediate ask — mitigate live impact, reduce p99 and stop stalls. Suggestions?

mike: rollback rollout flag to turn off prefix-scheme-v3 rollout. Endpoint: `POST /admin/feature_flags/rollout/prefix-scheme-v3/disable` (requires ops token). Also can enable `routing.fallback=legacy-prefix` to route missy requests to the old cache path.

raj: prewarm won't help until we stop changing keys. If we switch back to v2 salt, cache keys match existing KV and hits should recover.

ashley: on it — performing quick rollback now. Running: ```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/rollouts/DPL-7891/rollback" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"reason":"live p99 spike after prefix-scheme-v3"}'
```

ashley: rollback request accepted, status=rolling-back. Patch rolling back config -> expected propagate to edge in ~60s.

oncall-bot: Handoff: ashley is primary until 09:45 UTC, then mike takes over. Paging oncall-channel.

mike: after rollback propagate we should also disable the salting migration job to avoid reintroducing v3 keys. I'll add a guard in the migration cron.

eva: scaling note — paging systems (kv-store) are saturated on a couple of hosts. I'll spin up 2 extra nodes in eu-west-1 to reduce eviction churn: `infra scale kv-cluster eu-west-1 +2`. Doing now.

ashley: status update 09:07 — rollback completed across all runtime nodes. Observability shows prefix hit rate climbing: 12% -> 58% in 3m. p99 trending down to 980ms.

luis: ACME reporting partial recovery in streams, still seeing occasional stalls but much better.

raj: running audit to find which prefixes were salted into v3. Querying logs to list keys with `v3` suffix and backfilling an item-count estimate. If there are keys that only exist in v3, we need a small prewarm for the hot keyset.

mike: temporarily enabling routing fallback to legacy path to catch straggler traffic: ```
POST /admin/routing/fallback -d '{"enable":true, "target":"legacy-prefix"}'
```

nicholas: added alert mute for noisy p95 alerts for next 15m to avoid alert fatigue while we recover. Kept p99 alerts active.

ashley: 09:12 — p95 = 210ms, p99 = 540ms (still above baseline but recovering). Stream stall rate reduced to +40% vs baseline.

caroline: CS updated customers: we sent ACME and Papertrail interim note, asked to escalate if they see new errors; scheduled postmortem follow-up call.

ashley: next steps: 1) run a targeted prewarm for top-500 prefixes that had a v3 miss spike, 2) revert migration cron, 3) run canary of a corrected salting algorithm in staging and validate hit-rate before any re-rollout.

raj: I'll produce a small script to generate prewarm payloads: ```
# generate prewarm list
./tools/prefix-audit --since 09:00 --tag v3 > v3-hotlist.txt
./tools/prewarm --namespace app/prefix --keys v3-hotlist.txt --parallel 10
```

mike: also adding a temporary safety in runtime: if a request experiences >3 consecutive cache misses for same prefix within 2s, route to an async warm path instead of blocking the stream. I'll put a hotfix to runtime in a lite rollout.

eva: infra scaling complete, 2 nodes added, eviction rate fell ~30%.

ashley: 09:23 — p95 = 190ms, p99 = 320ms. Still above ideal but within SLO window after mutations. Ticketing: create postmortem and assign action owners. Who owns follow-ups?

mike: I'll take runtime hotfix (hotfix-3105).

raj: I'll take migration cron revert and prewarm script (task MIG-3105).

nicholas: I'll own dashboards and tweak alerts, add long-term metric for prefix-scheme migration impact.

caroline: CS will run customer followups and coordinate postmortem invites.

luis: support will track any remaining customer tickets and escalate if new symptoms appear.

oncall-bot: Handoff at 09:45 UTC — mike is now primary for incident until 11:00 UTC. ashley handing off with summary: rollback completed, routing fallback enabled, infra scaled, prewarm scheduled, p99 improving.

mike: leaving a runbook note: DO NOT re-enable prefix-scheme-v3 without a pre-rollout hit-rate verification against staging traffic and a gradual canary with KV warmers. Add a kill-switch accessible to SRE on-call.

ashley: logging the incident as INC-3105 in pagerduty with sev=SEV2. Started a postmortem doc `incidents/INC-3105-prefix-scheme-v3-rollout-regression` and added initial timeline.

caroline: posting customer follow-up draft to CS queue.

mike: closing the live mitigation channel here — any items not covered, annotate the postmortem. Great job team. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Monitoring for regressions for 2 hours.
